copper mountain.note: Good morning from Copper Mountain! Today's forecast calls for partly sunny skies with increasing clouds as a storm approaches. Temperatures will reach the upper 30s to low 40s, accompanied by light southerly winds. Snow is expected this evening, with the potential for up to 1 to 2 inches of new snow. We're also keeping an eye on the forecast for a possibly stronger storm this weekend! Our snowmaking and slope maintenance teams continue to work hard to expand open terrain while we eagerly wait for more snowfall. In the meantime, get out there and enjoy making turns! Remember to always ski and ride in control, stay aware of those around you, and respect all posted signs, closures, and ropes. Hope to see you on the mountain!

snowbird.note: Resort Update: All uphill travel is CLOSED for snowmaking and winter 2026/27 on-mountain preparation. Snowbird is scheduled to open for lift-serviced operations on November 27. Mountain Report: Winter has arrived at Snowbird! With five inches of fresh snow throughout the afternoon, and no sign of this storm slowing down for the next few days, the road to opening day is looking nice and white. We hope to see you at Opening Day on Black Friday, November 27, conditions permitting. While we are all ever-so-patiently waiting to get back on board, join us for Pre-Season Passholder Appreciation Day on November 21. Come build some preseason stoke, pick up your season pass and UDOT sticker (we are 100% back in snow tire season) and get your skis or snowboard waxed by our friends at Board Budder . Passholder Appreciation Day details Then, carbo-load for Opening Day with Thanksgiving at Snowbird . Bring the family, make a reservation and leave the cooking and cleanup to us. And Season Passholders, don't forget about your Early Bird Benefit (Passholder's who bought/renewed by May 13). Your free night at The Cliff Lodge is valid through December 17. The first couple of weekends of ski season are always exciting ones, so get your stay on the books while availability allows. The mountain is white. Snowmaking is underway. Opening Day is getting closer. Give me The Bird
